---
title: "Commitlint"
description: "Checks that every commit in a PR follows Conventional Commits."
---

`commitlint.yml` lints every commit of the pull request against
[Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org), e.g.
`feat: add ds.mean wrapper` or `fix(ds.summary): handle NA input`.

This matters beyond style: the [release](package-release.qmd) derives the
next version from these prefixes — `fix:` gives a patch, `feat:` a minor
and a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer (or `feat!:`) a major release.

## Example

{{< example commitlint.yml >}}

## Rules

The shared configuration extends `@commitlint/config-conventional`, with
one change: commit headers may be up to **150** characters (default 100).
Body and footer lines are still limited to 100 characters.
